subject: Governing OK to Proceed: final acceptance, signatures and Day 1
messages:
From: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@acme.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Governing OK to Proceed: final acceptance and signature timing

Hi Irene / Karthik,

Appreciate the MAP walkthrough yesterday. Acme leadership (+ CFO Tom Ellis and our GC) are aligned with the scope and evaluation outcomes. Before we finalize the internal approvals I need one clear timeline from Redwood so I can schedule signers and procurement:

- Who exactly needs to sign from your side (order + legal sequence)?
- What is your preferred signature window (we prefer to cluster signatures to avoid multiple round trips)?
- Can you confirm target Day 1 / start date range? We are looking at early June but can be flexible.

We have two constraints on our side: CFO is travelling the week of May 24 (hard blackout), and the GC prefers to sign the legal suite after procurement signs (preferred two-step). If you can provide a short, sequenced plan with dates I can lock in both signers. Also include where we will see the final SOW/order form and DocuSign link.

Attached: our internal acceptance note (short).

Thanks,
Samantha Ruiz
Head of Platform Partnerships
Acme Retail

Attachments: Acme_acceptance_note.pdf (attached by sender)
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@acme.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Governing OK to Proceed: final acceptance and signature timing

Samantha — thanks, and congrats to the team on the positive evaluation. High level plan below, proposing a compact window so we can close before your travel blackout: 

Summary of required approvals (Redwood side):
1) Procurement acceptance (order form) — Sales ownership (Monica)
2) Legal review & countersign — Legal counsel (Karthik)
3) Security/compliance acknowledgement — Security lead (Marcus) for SOC2 confirmation

Proposed sequencing and dates (target):
- May 18: Procurement signs order form (Monica will own execution)
- May 19: Legal signs agreement (Karthik will route countersign)
- May 20: Security & onboarding checklist confirmed, DocuSign finalized

Target Day 1 (provisioning + kickoff): June 1, 2027 (this gives a 10-day handover for account provisioning, initial runbook and canary). If you need earlier start we can compress but it will require overnight signature turnaround.

Mechanics:
- We'll send the order form (Order_Form_ACME_1932.xlsx) and MAP v4 (attached) as a single package.
- DocuSign envelope will be 2-step: procurement signer first, legal second. There will be a single envelope but two signature tabs in sequence.
- For SOC2 evidence we will attach a short summary here and make the full report available in the shared Drive folder.

Action items for Acme:
- Confirm Tom Ellis (CFO) and your GC availability for May 18-19 window
- Confirm preferred start date (we recommend June 1)

I will loop Marcus for the compliance note after you confirm signers.

Best,
Irene Choi
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Quick note from legal: sequence looks good. If Tom (CFO) can sign May 18 morning we can run legal review the same day and place countersign on May 19 afternoon. Please confirm:

- CFO available May 18, morning (preferred)
- GC available May 19 (we will hold a short 20–30m review call if any redlines arise)

If we get signatures by EOD May 19 we can have the DocuSign envelope fully executed by May 20 and target Day 1 remains June 1.

Karthik

Thanks — quick updates from our side:
- Tom (CFO) confirmed availability May 18 morning (I put him on this thread).

Also, can Redwood confirm whether onboarding provisioning will include a dedicated VLAN and expected provisioning ETA? Our infra team needs the IP allocation window for firewall rules.

I'll expect the draft and the DocuSign link.

- May 20: Redwood Security (Marcus) confirms onboarding checklist and provisioning windows. Marcus: please prepare IP allocation range and expected VLAN provisioning ETA (we'll attach a technical onboarding sheet).
- May 21 EOD: Target to have fully executed DocuSign envelope and digital artifacts (SOW, order form, signature pages).
- June 1, 2027: Day 1 — account provisioning, kickoff call, and first canary run.
